scale_history_note: Asteroxylon chronoseries is 1/1 at 407 Ma. There is no earlier named Asteroxylon chronospecies in this series. The grade predecessor is Cooksonia (leafless, no actinostele). The grade successor is a fully microphyllous lycopsid such as Baragwanathia. The scale predecessor inside Asteroxylon is the 283 µm enation-spacing mode, which this 5.2 µm slot does not reuse.
